raw_matrix: A unique identification number assigned to the claim. I H
A facility’s Medicare/Medicaid identification number (Medicare/Medicaid Provider Number or CCN). H
A Medicare Beneficiary Identifier assigned to a beneficiary. I H
Legacy Beneficiary HICN field; blank in CCLFs effective Jan 1, 2020 onwards. I H
Signifies the type of claim being submitted; codes include 10=HHA,20=Non swing bed SNF,30=Swing bed SNF,40=Outpatient,50=Hospice,60=Inpatient,61=Inpatient Full-Encounter. H
The first day on the billing statement that covers services rendered to the beneficiary (Statement Covers From Date). H
The last day on the billing statement that covers services rendered to the beneficiary (Statement Covers Through Date). H

The first digit of the type of bill identifies facility type; codes include 1=Hospital,2=SNF,3=HHA,4=Religious non-medical hospital,5=Religious non-medical extended care,6=Intermediate care,7=Clinic or hospital-based renal dialysis facility,8=Specialty facility or ASC,9=Reserved. H
The second digit of the type of bill indicates where the service was provided (department within facility). H
The ICD-9/10 diagnosis code identifying the beneficiary’s principal illness or disability. H
The ICD-9/10 diagnosis code identifying the illness or disability for which the beneficiary was admitted. H
Indicates the reason payment on an institutional claim is denied. See ResDAC for codes.
Amount that Medicare paid on the claim. H
Indicates the primary payer if other than Medicare; blank means Medicare is primary. See ResDAC for codes. H
Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) State Code
Identifies the state where the facility providing services is located.
Indicates the patient’s discharge status as of the Claim Through Date (e.g., discharged to home, another facility, against medical advice, death). I H
Indicates the diagnostic related group for prospective payment purposes. I H
Code reported by provider indicating specific type of claim; values include 0=Blank,1=Emergency,2=Urgent,3=Elective,5-8=Reserved,9=Unknown. I H
Identifies the facility associated with the claim; each facility has a unique NPI.
Identifies the operating provider associated with the claim; each provider has a unique NPI.
Identifies the attending provider associated with the claim; each provider has a unique NPI.
Identifies other providers associated with the claim; each provider has a unique NPI.
Indicates whether the claim is original, cancellation, or adjustment; 0=Original,1=Cancellation,2=Adjustment.
Date the claim was processed and added to the NCH (NCH Weekly Processing Date). H
Date when the claim was loaded into the IDR.
Legacy Beneficiary Equitable BIC HICN Number; blank in CCLFs effective Jan 1, 2020 onwards.
Indicates type and priority of inpatient services; codes include 0=Blank,1=Emergency,2=Urgent,3=Elective,4=Newborn,5=Trauma Center,6-8=Reserved,9=Unknown. I H
Indicates source of referral for admission or visit; see ResDAC for codes.
The third digit of the type of bill (TOB3) indicating sequence of claim in episode of care; see ResDAC for codes.
Indicates type of claim record being processed with respect to payment; codes include 0=Credit adjustment,1=Interim bill,2=HHA benefits exhausted,3=Final bill,4=Discharge notice,5=Debit adjustment.
Total charges for all services on the institutional claim; redundant with revenue center code 0001/total charges.
Claim Capital Indirect Medical Education Amount
Amount of IME portion of PPS payment for capital (teaching hospitals only); applicable for claim type 60; total calculated based on debit/credit methodology.
Claim Operational Indirect Medical Education Amount
Indirect medical education amount applicable to the bill (exclude PPS capital IME); applicable for claim type 60; total calculated based on debit/credit methodology.
Amount of disproportionate share portion of PPS payment for capital; effective 3/2/92; applicable for claim type 60; total calculated based on debit/credit methodology.
Claim Health Insurance Prospective Payment System Uncompensated Care Amount
Payment for DSH hospitals representing uncompensated care amount; applicable for claim types 10,20,30,40,50,60; total calculated based on debit/credit methodology.
Disproportionate share amount applicable to the bill (use PRICER amount; exclude PPS capital DSH adjustment); applicable for claim type 60; total calculated based on debit/credit methodology.
